title.narrative: Youth Lead establishing a youth sector working group in Palestine

description.narrative: Recruitment of a Youth Coordinator who will be responsible for the project and leading the establishment and coordination of the youth sector working group. Conduct a mapping of youth actors which will inform all future activities Conduct YLO/YRO capacity and needs assessment through consultations and roundtables with relevant stakeholders. ActionAid and PNGO to establish a youth sector working group (SWG) under the Local Aid Coordination Secretariat (LACS). LACS supports SWGs and provides specific inputs into aid coordination platforms, donor advisory groups, and the LACS steering committee1. Monthly meetings will be held with youth, YLO/YROs. In the beginning, these meetings will produce a TOR for the YSWG containing the composition, description, principles, membership criteria, and areas of responsibility. The YSWG will be central to the subsequent activities. Establish a social media platform to be able to reach youth organisations in marginalized and vulnerable areas. The platform will be the window to present and investigate the needs of youth for later preparing an innovative means for responding to these needs. PNGO will conduct six participatory capacity strengthening sessions targeting YLO/YROs. From past studies that have been conducted, these could include topics such as MEAL, accountability, gender transformative marker, data and digital security, or fundraising and communications. The topics of the trainings will be decided and tailored, based on the outcomes of the YLO/YRO capacity and needs assessments. PNGO will conduct one capacity strengthening session on the humanitarian-development-peacebuilding-climate nexus for YLO/YROs. This is a need seen across the local civil society struggling with the current context and will support YLO/YROs to connect their emergency interventions with the long-term resilience outlook. PNGO, ActionAid and YSWG members will develop a nexus case study to support practical understanding of the nexus approach PNGO, ActionAid and YSWG members will produce six fact sheets, policy papers or position papers tackling the main issues related to youth in emergencies, early recovery, and reconstruction stages. PNGO, ActionAid, YSWG members will hold advocacy workshops with different actors such as government ministries, UN agencies, and INGOs to discuss the real role of youth in emergencies, early recovery, and reconstruction stages and to pressure them to ensure that the youth needs are included in their strategic plans and programs. Based on the need assessment results, provide support to YLO/YROs to create or update their internal policies and manuals. The policies will be replicable for other YLO/YROs to adopt and adapt. The support will be tailored and could look like sub-grants to YLO/YROs or direct support from PNGO.

This project will establish a mechanism in which youth-led and youth rights organisations will have increased voice, ownership and access to resources, which is in line with ActionAid’s commitment to young people, and ActionAid’s humanitarian signature which promotes youth leadership. This project will actively target organisations led by young women, and the inclusion of gender will be central throughout the working group’s establishment.
